notes: AMBIGUOUS: मैं (I) or में (in). Also an English word (main reason, main page). Rule picks from neighbours; unsure -> logged.
English 'me' too. Converted only inside a Hindi context; prior reading is में.
Usually मैं; sloppy spelling of में also occurs. Same rule as main but no English reading.
English 'men'. Converted only next to a Hindi word.
AMBIGUOUS: कि (that) or की (of). Rule: after pata/hai/lagta.. or before aap/main/yeh.. -> कि, else की.
English 'to'. Converted only right after a Hindi word (or clause-initial before a Hindi word).
English greeting 'Hi'. Converted only right after a Hindi word.
English 'is'. Converted only before a Hindi word and not after an English word.
English 'us'. Converted only before a Hindi word and not after an English word.
English 'the'. Converted only right after a Hindi word (hote the).
English 'do'. दो (two / give). Converted before a Hindi word or a counted noun (do din), or after a Hindi verb (bata do).
English 'are'. Converted only clause-initially before a Hindi word.
English 'per' (per month). Converted only next to a Hindi word.
